title: Finite quotient cohomology of constructible integral sheaves with scalar models
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $F/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_F$ with its induced $\ell$-adic norm topology, and a uniformizer $\pi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $T$, put $B_T=p_T^*\underline A$ and $k_{n,T}=(A/\pi^n)_T$ for $n\ge1$. Use the small pro-étale sites and universes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the ordinary unbounded derived module categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $C_T(K)=R\varprojlim_{n\ge1}\operatorname{Res}_n(K\otimes^L_{B_T}k_{n,T})$ and $c_{T,K}:K\to C_T(K)$ for the specified strict-tower completion unit [sk-def-pe-derived-completion, lem-pe-completion-triangle-comparison].
Let $V$ be qcqs and $M$ a constructible $B_V$-module in the finite constant scalar-model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Put $M_n=M[0]\otimes^L_{B_V}k_{n,V}$. Then $A/\pi^n$ is a finite discrete ring and $H^q(M_n)=0$ for $q\notin[-1,0]$, uniformly for all $n\ge1$. Each $M_n$ is bounded constructible both in the internal finite constant scalar-model sense and, under [lem-sf-module-object-ordinary-coefficient-equivalence], as an ordinary pro-étale complex with finite constructible cohomology [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf].
More precisely, choose a finite constructible locally closed stratification witnessing constructibility of $M$ and trivializing pro-étale covers of its strata. On any such covering scheme $U$ with $M|_U\simeq B_U\otimes_{\underline A}\underline P$, any exact scalar resolution $0\to A^a\xrightarrow{u}A^b\to P\to0$ with $a,b$ finite gives an isomorphism in the derived category of $k_{n,U}$-modules
$$M_n|_U\simeq[k_{n,U}^a\xrightarrow{\overline u}k_{n,U}^b],$$
with terms in degrees $-1,0$. In ordinary finite-coefficient coordinates its cohomology sheaves are the constant sheaves of $\ker(\overline u:(A/\pi^n)^a\to(A/\pi^n)^b)$ and $\operatorname{coker}(\overline u)$. These scalar modules are finite and finitely presented over $A/\pi^n$. The isomorphisms use the actual quotient homomorphism $A\to A/\pi^n$ and commute with restriction to the stated strata and covers. No geometric condition involving $\ell$, Noetherianity or completeness hypothesis on $M$ is assumed.

proof.text: The positive quotient is finite by finite_coefficientExtensionRing. Its recorded topology is discrete by the uniformizer coset neighbourhood basis, transported from spectralNorm.normedField to coefficientExtensionAbsoluteValue.toNormedField via equality of their pseudometric structures. Choose the existing normalized Encoding at every scheme.

Apply the specified chart comparison. The literal double complex has homology kernel in degree -1 and cokernel in degree 0; exact constant realization transports these identifications. The categorical kernel is equivalent to a submodule of a finite power and the cokernel to a quotient of a finite power, so both are finite. Finite modules over the finite ring are finitely presented by Module.finitePresentation_of_finite. This constructs every field of LocalCalculation in Lean.

Apply cohomology descent to this LocalCalculation. Its global vanishing supplies bounds -1 and 0 through DerivedCategory.isGE_iff and isLE_iff. Combine boundedness with the internal constructibility assertions. The termwise exact encoding preserves boundedness, which combined with the fixed intrinsic constructibility assertions gives OrdinaryConclusion. Package these with the local calculation and coefficient facts.
